description: Sturdy and classic in appearance, this Libbey 8054 6 oz. Georgian Irish coffee glass maintains Libbey's long-time standards of extraordinarily durable products. Featuring a durable, crystal clear form, this glass is designed to provide optimum clarity and brilliance. The traditional design creates an eye-catching presentation for irish coffees and other dessert drinks. In addition, the thick, decorative stem and pedestal foot provides stability on tabletops. No matter what you serve, this elegant glass will add aesthetic appeal to any drink presentation.
